description.zh: 需删除的Topic所对应的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance that contains the topic to delete.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>
- 阿里云提供的OpenAPI属于管控类API，用于管理和查询阿里云服务的相关资源。仅推荐在管控链路集成，消息收发的核心数据链路中严禁依赖OpenAPI实现，否则可能会导致链路产生风险。
- 删除Topic将导致该Topic下所有的发布订阅关系同时被清理，请慎重调用。></notice>
本接口一般是在应用下线等资源回收场景下使用。
Topic删除时后台需要做资源回收，速度较慢，因此不建议删除后立即又重新创建。如果删除失败，请根据错误码进行处理。
descriptions.en:
><notice>

\- Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI is a control plane API used to manage and query resources of Alibaba Cloud services. Integrate this API only on the control plane. Do not use OpenAPI in the core data link for sending and receiving messages. This can create threats to your data link.
\- Deleting a topic also deletes all of its subscription relationships. Call this operation with caution.

></notice>


This operation is typically used for resource revocation, such as when an application is unpublished.
When a topic is deleted, its resources are revoked in the background. This process is slow. Do not immediately recreate a topic after deleting it. If the deletion fails, handle the error based on the error code.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-topic-delete --topic test --instance-id MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsTopicDelete --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --Topic test
